about_short_description.short_description: PermitPortal offers AI insights, local intelligence, and automated workflows for developers to navigate pre-construction processes.

product.name: Dev-Tracker
product.description: A platform that monitors development projects by tracking agendas, meeting minutes, documents, and approvals across the U.S., providing insights on project status and timelines.

product.name: Site Sourcing
product.description: An AI-powered site discovery tool that filters properties by zoning, location, size, and build potential, providing real-time property insights and due diligence reports.

product.name: Site Due Diligence
product.description: Provides instant property analysis reports covering zoning, environmental factors, and infrastructure assessments to support development decisions.

product.name: City Intelligence
product.description: Offers comprehensive analysis of jurisdictions including approval timelines and development sentiment to inform project planning and compliance.

product.name: Jurisdiction Assistant
product.description: An AI tool that provides instant answers to complex development questions related to local regulations and processes.

product.name: City Updates
product.description: Tracks planning decisions and regulatory changes in real time to keep users informed about local development environments.
